artworks.title: A Pastoral Journey with a Boy Playing His Flute by a Tree
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with people and animals in a natural landscape. The horizon line is near the top, with hills and trees in the distance. A tree stands on the left, with figures like cows, sheep, and shepherds. A young boy plays a flute by a tree on the left. A man sits among cows on the right. The style includes detailed linework and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is primarily sepia, giving a vintage feel.

artworks.title: A Pastoral Journey with a Child in a Basket on Horseback
artworks.artist: Gaetano Zompini, after Giovanni Benedetto Castiglione
artworks.medium: etching in sanguine on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with people and animals depicted through etching. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering an overview of the scene. A group of sheep is being herded in the foreground, with detailed textures. In the center, a figure rides a donkey carrying baskets, alongside a leading figure gesturing. The background features hills, mountains, and trees. The etching uses shades of brown for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Characteristics of King Frederik II (Part III)
artworks.medium: set of four etchings printed on one sheet of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four scenes involving soldiers and horses. The artwork consists of four distinct scenes divided in a two-by-two grid. In the two upper panels, chaotic and crowded scenes can be observed with figures and horses in various dynamic poses, as well as some architectural elements and foliage. Text written in a language with a Germanic appearance is present above these panels. In the two lower panels, there are groups of soldiers, some on horseback, gathered on what appears to be a battlefield. The scenes depict a sense of movement and preparation among the troops. The sky is full of clouds, which are etched delicately behind the lines of soldiers and horses. Each panel includes a small text description at the bottom in German, providing possible titles or narration for each scene. The lines and shading appear finely detailed, indicating a classic etching technique.

artworks.title: Charakteristik Friedrichs II (Part III)
artworks.medium: set of four etchings in proof states with remarques, printed on one sheet of laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 24.1 x 18.4 cm (9 1/2 x 7 1/4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four historical scenes arranged in a grid. Each scene features groups of mounted and unmounted soldiers engaging in different activities within tented military camps. The top half of the image shows two vignettes with soldiers in combat or parade formations in landscapes, while the lower half presents two vignettes with soldiers in discussions or resting in military gatherings. The scenes depict historical military campaigns with backdrops of landscapes, tents, and war accouterments, emphasizing military life and strategy. Latin or German inscriptions above or below each scene provide context for the military actions.

artworks.title: Anecdotes of King Frederik II
artworks.medium: set of three etchings in proof states with remarques, printed on one sheet of laid paper
artworks.description: There are three separate rectangular panels. The first panel shows several men in a room, the second panel shows men surrounding a canopy bed with a man lying on it, and the third panel shows a group of soldiers gathered around a central figure near a fire. The men are all dressed in historical attire.

artworks.title: Anecdotes of King Frederik II
artworks.medium: set of three etchings in proof states with remarques, printed on one sheet of laid paper
artworks.description:
The image is a triptych with different scenes. 

Left panel: Two figures standing and kneeling facing each other. Both wear coats, knee-length breeches, and tricorn hats, in front of an ornate patterned wall.

Middle panel: Two figures, one standing and gesturing, the other seated and pointing. Both wear elaborate coats and hats with faint figures and signs of combat behind them in a smoky setting.

Right panel: A person on horseback with a cocked hat, handing an object to a standing man. Soldiers with spears stand in formation in the background.

artworks.title: The Prussian Royal Family
artworks.medium: etching [proof with remarque] on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a group of people in an interior setting and trees in a landscape. The upper section shows an indoor scene with individuals in formal attire gathered in a room with a table and drapery. The lower part shows a detailed outdoor scene with trees. The drawing emphasizes contrast and depth with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Troisieme livre de formes Cartels et Rocailles (Title Page)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural structure with spiral stairs and decorative elements surrounded by foliage. The drawing features a decorative archway with Baroque elements, including relief sculptures and scrollwork. Atop the archway is a seated statue figure with trees in the background. The text on the archway features a baroque typography. Beneath the archway, a set of spiral stairs lead up to the structure. On the right side, a large ornamental vase holds an array of florals. Overall, the drawing is richly detailed, with complex textural effects and fine lines.

artworks.title: L'Amour Couronnée
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and curves forming an abstract composition resembling elaborate details found in Baroque architecture. The design features intricate foliage and waves, some curling inwards like scrolls. Fluffy cloud-like clusters are present, with two cherubic figures visible within. The artwork evokes a decorative piece inspired by natural forms and celestial imagery.

artworks.title: Le Galand Chasseur
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals, a man and a woman. The man is kneeling on one knee in a posture suggestive of presenting something to the woman, who is standing and extending her hands as if to receive his offering. The man has medium-length curly hair and is dressed in 18th-century attire, while the woman wears a dress with ruffles. Both figures have classical facial features. The background features an ornate fountain with cascading water and lush foliage, typical of prints from the romantic or rococo era.

artworks.title: l'Heureux Moment
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an interior scene with two people seated close to each other. The person on the left is an older man wearing a coat with cuffs and a cravat. The person on the right is a woman in a gown with elaborate patterns. They are positioned intimately, with the man's arm around the woman's shoulder, engaged in conversation. The setting includes an ornate piece of furniture with a bouquet of flowers, a draped curtain, and a table with various objects, such as a mirror, a vessel, and books. The background features a wall with intricate designs.

artworks.title: Le Rendez-vous
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows an elaborate fountain setup. The focal point is a large, stylized fountain with flowing water cascading into a pool. Surrounding the fountain are intricate Rococo-style design elements like swirling lines, floral motifs, and a decorative urn with flowers at the top center. In the background, there are detailed foliage suggesting a garden setting. The artwork emphasizes the opulence of the Rococo period with rich decorative detail.

artworks.title: l'Amoureux Guerrier
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a black and white drawing depicting a domestic scene against a rustic backdrop. Various architectural elements like columns and drapes are in the foreground. A couple is seated in the center, surrounded by detailed foliage and an intricate sky in the background. The drawing shows attention to detail and deliberate composition.

artworks.title: l'Officieux Valet
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a large decorative scroll with floral designs, a hanging game animal, kitchen items like a cabbage, an artichoke, and a cooking pot. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of brown and cream. The scroll is positioned to the right, framing the collection of objects, while a vase or urn is on the left side with a small figure in the background. The objects are arranged in a still life composition.

artworks.title: The Head of Saint George and Architectural Plans (verso)
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of faint architectural sketches. The image depicts a sheet of paper with light red pencil or ink sketches, faintly outlining architectural elements or structures. The paper shows signs of age, with various small stains, smudges, and wear marks. The sketches are not easily recognizable as detailed plans, but suggest a series of connected geometrical shapes. Remnants of pink pigment suggest previous attempts at illustration. The overall appearance is that of an unfinished or rough draft, typically used for early design or conceptualization in architecture.

artworks.title: A Waterfall with Ruins (verso)
artworks.medium: gray wash heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall flowing down a rocky landscape, surrounded by ancient ruins and overgrowth. The horizon is hidden by dense vegetation and tall structures on the sides. The brushstrokes are fluid, especially in the foliage and water. The color palette consists of muted earth tones, with shades of brown and green. In the background, faint ruins are seen blending into the scenery.

artworks.title: Rapids with Overhanging Branches (verso)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, with gray wash and watercolor, heightened with white gouache on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The painting displays a rushing stream seen from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The scene is filled with dense foliage, twisting branches creating an overhead canopy, and shadows on the water. Large rocks are scattered in the water, with energetic currents swirling around them. The brushstrokes depict the water's motion and leaf texture, with swirls and patches of light. The color palette includes muted greens, grays, browns, and hints of white representing frothy water. The overall image conveys a vibrant natural scene filled with lush greenery and flowing water.

artworks.title: Two Male Figures in Motion (verso)
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper washed brown
artworks.creditLine: Wolfgang Ratjen Collection, Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: This is a drawing of stylized forms depicting a figure with flowing lines. The artwork consists of loose, curved lines and dark smudges against a light brown background. The lines suggest a figure with intricate detailing, possibly with hair or other flowing elements, giving it a sense of movement and organic forms. The shading and the sketchy nature of the lines give it an unfinished yet expressive quality. The interplay of lines and shading creates a textural depth within the composition.

artworks.title: Environs de Gravesend
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint and aquatint on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene from a high vantage point. The horizon is high, with a skyline of various ships, including a dominant sailing ship on the right and smaller boats. The etching style features detailed linear brushstrokes for texture on water, sky, ships, and structures. The color palette is mainly sepia tones. A figure stands on a dock looking at the water, where boats are tied. Smoke rises from ships in the distance, blending with the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Trompe l'Oeil: A Full House with Chips and a $5 Bill
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite mounted on cardboard
artworks.description: The image shows a five-dollar bill positioned horizontally in the foreground, with five playing cards and several poker chips partially beneath and beside it. The color palette includes earthy tones on the bill and a mix of bright red, blue, and white on the poker chips, along with multicolored designs on the playing cards. The cards fan out diagonally on the left side behind the bill, while the chips are scattered around the lower left and right edges of the card spread, with the central bill overlaying some of them.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with God the Father
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate: 20.5 x 14.5 cm (8 1/16 x 5 11/16 in.); cut to platemark
artworks.description: Three figures are shown in the image, arranged vertically. On the left, a seated woman is holding a child on her lap. The woman has wavy hair and wears a draped garment. The child has curly hair and is reaching towards the right. On the right, a bearded man is kneeling with clasped hands and holding a staff. The background features clouds, two airborne figures, and architectural elements.

artworks.title: La Coquetterie
artworks.medium: drypoint with roulette on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual in profile, with legs extended forward on an ornate bench. The person has short hair with a circular decoration, possibly a wreath or headband. The individual is holding a skull while appearing to examine it closely. The background features a classical motif below the bench and a smaller sketch of another undressed figure in the top left corner. The overall background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Blonde
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and roulette on japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure rendered in a delicate and somewhat incomplete manner. The person is shown kneeling with raised arms, hands intertwined above their head. Their facial features are subtle, with a focus on the eyes and mouth. The person's hair is long and appears to flow upward, following the line of their arms. They are unclothed, shown in a minimalist style with gentle shading outlining the form. There are no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is an abstract, shaded area, creating a soft, textured contrast to the figure, with darker tones near the edges that fade toward the center of the composition.

artworks.title: Washerwomen Setting the Linens Out to Dry
artworks.medium: black charcoal with brown pastel on wove paper laid down on board
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Merritt Porter Dyke in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: The image shows an outdoor scene with a group of people engaged in various activities. The perspective is positioned near the people. The horizon aligns with the tops of trees, adding depth. The drawing uses delicate lines to depict the grass and tree bark. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey for contrast. A woman holds cloth or laundry, looking at a man seated next to a fabric or a blanket. Another woman stands nearby, surrounded by trees. Branches above spread out in a detailed pattern, casting light shadows.
